scope: packages/core/src and packages/cli/src as named in the prompt, with tests
constraints: Follow the ship brief and AGENTS.md.

acceptance_criteria: B1: a long Assignment objective keeps its SessionStart row (id, agent_id) by clipping row text inside the fit-to-budget steps, with a gentler ladder than whole-then-120; a regression test fails on the current change.

F1: observe checks the holyclaude agent type before reading the observations log; observation generations are read as a bounded tail (dropping a partial first line) so a huge repo-supplied log cannot stall a hook; the PreToolUse deny verdict is emitted without waiting on observation recording.
F2: validateState duplicate and membership checks are linear (Set-based); SessionStart reads state with a generous bound (64 MiB) and degrades to rules plus a state error instead of hanging.
F4: legacy log migration moves the file when the target is absent and appends without loading both whole otherwise.
The 64 KiB CLI stdin JSON cap is removed; hook stdin bounds stay.
README describes these behaviors; regression tests fail on the base and pass after; format, lint, typecheck and test pass; bundle rebuilt with Bun 1.4.3.
